dataset_info.description: Temple University Hospital EEG Events Corpus: clinical EEG with six annotated event types.
dataset_info.reference: Harati, A., Golmohammadi, M., Lopez, S., Obeid, I., & Picone, J. (2015). Improved EEG event classification using differential energy. IEEE SPMB.
dataset_info.notes: Train: patient folders; eval: session folders (a session index, not a patient: its subject id is 'eval<idx>'). EEG-FM-Bench splits all windows at random (0.8 / 0.1 / 0.1), so subject ids only group a patient's files.
